scope: Finite radiation trains generate a common companion field. Compare packet spacing at fixed incoming power and a power control, measuring weak-probe mean stretch, drift and sampled residual variation. No steady cosmic source population, adopted matter clocks, capture or galaxy gravity.

sample_statistics.scope: Unweighted nonuniform launch-time sample over a finite window; drift subtraction is descriptive, not removal of physical variation.
